description: This PHP source file defines a class 'ReportingMethodMenuConfigurator' which implements the 'MenuConfigurator' interface. It is responsible for configuring menu items related to reporting methods within the OrangeHRM PIM module, by overriding the screen for reporting methods view.

classes.name: ReportingMethodMenuConfigurator
classes.description: A class that configures the menu for reporting methods within the PIM module, overriding the screen to 'viewReportingMethods'.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets the current module and screen to 'viewReportingMethods' and returns null, implementing the MenuConfigurator interface method.
